svg.text: Y = field used . value = what it carries . - = don't-care. addr is REUSED: row(ACT) | col(RD/WR) | MRA(+data)(MRW/MRR) | op(MPC).

svg.text: - ALL rows go through DFI_CMD_ENCODE -> CA[13:0] beats + dfi_cs (one CA bus, one issue point).

text.font-family: Inter, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: - 2ui is NOT a record field: SEPARATE single flag scheduler -> DFI driver (outside port). 1=2-UI

text.font-family: Inter, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
Inter, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: - RD/WR arm the data path: WR->WL_LAUNCH (sram=wd_slot), RD->RD_CAP (sram=dbuf).

text.font-family: Inter, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: - MRR reads MR on DQ -> arms RD_CAP too (sram=sideband, rob=return tag) - why it can't be offloaded.

text.font-family: Inter, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: - PDE/PDX (power-down) are NOT phaser records - pure dfi_cke transitions (POWER_MGMT).

text.font-family: Inter, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: - bg/bank are DDR5-encoded INTO addr/CA (no dfi_bg/dfi_bank pins); PREsb/REFsb use bank index k across all BGs.
